text: The Galaxy Feast. Hello, hello, captain! I am Chef Gorbo. Tonight I cook the Galaxy Feast for a hundred hungry space travellers. One chef, four pans, and no ingredients!
The shopping list. I need a giant moon-melon, a wheel of stinky comet cheese, five crates of food and three of lollies for pudding. The cheese is near pirates, so take care!
Quick, quick! The melon and cheese are paid for. The food and lollies you buy at any market, and I pay you well. Quick, the ovens are hot!
Dinner is served. Magnificent! The melon soup bubbles, the cheese is melting, and the lolly pudding wobbles. A hundred happy tummies, all thanks to you!
Compliments to the captain. Here is your pay, captain, and my golden spoon. Every great cook needs a great delivery captain!
